design.role: prospectively fixed descriptive mechanism study, no confirmatory tests
design.reporting: all graphs including extinction; equal graph weighting; graph bootstrap descriptive 95 percent intervals, 4000 resamples; all 3 rates and 2 controls; no significance selection
design.primary_descriptive_contrast: dynamic natural minus frozen natural post-withdrawal loss
design.feedback: paired mean-memory difference dynamic natural minus dynamic reset, minus exp(-lambda*t)*mean(initial natural memory); all time points, signed means and absolute paired deviation; not rebound probability
design.compression: move detailed search implementation and runtime interpretation to supplement without removing results
